notes.decision: Fits with guardrails. The per-person revoke sits beside the whole-client revoke on the existing 'Keys for automated tools' table (the surface decided in DI-03DA64D1850B; placement scored in DI-48D40418A3B5), as a 'People' disclosure on each active browser-registered client row. No new route, tab or navigation entry. A per-user 'connected apps' view on the user admin (Google Workspace's shape) was considered and left for later: the operator's question starts from the client, not the person.
notes.persona: An administrator who sees that a shared AI-client registration still holds grants for an account nobody uses ends that one account's access, with a reason, without disconnecting themselves or anyone else.
notes.reuse: Composes Surface, Button, DataTable, StatusBadge, Notice and promptDialog with --dpf-* theme tokens; the operator gate is the existing requireOperator().
notes.sourceTruth: McpApiToken and OAuthRefreshToken rows for (client, person) via listOAuthClientPeople / revokeOAuthClientPersonGrants; revokedAt and revokedReason record the time, operator and reason.
notes.states: Loading shows the table skeleton; nobody connected says so; each person shows live grants, last use and a status (Connected, Expired, or 'Revoked <time>: <reason>'). The caller's row reads 'You' and has no revoke button. Revoke asks for a required reason in a danger dialog that names the person and says everyone else stays connected; the outcome or the server's refusal shows in a Notice. Status is text plus badge, never colour alone. Headless (credentials) clients have no People control because they belong to no person.
notes.aiBoundary: No control sends a coworker prompt. Revoking a person's grants is an operator action under the operator's own role.
notes.verification: Unit tests for the domain function (isolation, attribution, self-protection, refusals, listing) with web typecheck; live verification on the canonical runtime after self-upgrade, revoking admin@dpf.local under the shared Claude Code registration and confirming the operator's grants stay live.
